d:
Orange County Choppers takes on a unique custom motorcycle build for the Iowa Farm Bureau, with one major requirement: the bike must run on E85 ethanol fuel. Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the crew face technical challenges as they adapt the fuel system and engine for the renewable fuel.
Farm-inspired details, tractor-style wheels and a striking green-and-gold paint scheme bring the agricultural theme to life. Watch American Chopper Season 4 for a motorcycle build that combines custom fabrication, American farming and alternative fuel technology.
